looks.label: player-colour twin frames
looks.technique: each soldier frame has a _pc.png twin for player tint

looks.label: result-specific battle clips
looks.technique: separate success and failure clips per direction for attack and evade, plus die clips; clip picked by logic random among those matching the level

looks.label: level ladder icons
looks.technique: one icon per level for health (0-3) and attack (0-5), loaded by pattern

looks.label: lava texture cycle
looks.technique: six frames at 4 fps with a dither layer blend at the rim

looks.label: critter animation set
looks.technique: idle at 10 fps, directional walk at 20 fps with six directions, menu icon

looks.label: critter idle sound with play chance
looks.technique: sound_effect with priority 3 percent on idle

looks.label: golden-tier gear
looks.technique: top gear tiers are golden or gilded named wares, each with an idle.png

originals.name: Four-Track Veteran
originals.idea: soldier with four tracks, each a base, a per-level step and an icon ladder
originals.keep: four tracks and icon ladders above the unit
originals.change: tracks are guard, stamina, crit and reach; rune-ladder icons and a glow rim for veterans

originals.name: Gear-Fed Training
originals.idea: each level consumes one gear piece plus food at a training site
originals.keep: one gear piece and food per level
originals.change: gear comes from loot drops, not a workshop chain

originals.name: Gilded Top Tier
originals.idea: top gear step costs double food
originals.change: gold shows as an edge glow and a short stinger, not a metal colour

originals.name: Result Clip
originals.idea: separate success and failure clips per direction so the result reads without a number
originals.change: one clip with a result glyph, hitstop on the hit frame, dust curl on a miss

originals.name: Food-Web Critters
originals.idea: size, reproduction and appetite numbers plus a carnivore flag define predator and prey
originals.change: predators raid field edges, not herds

originals.name: Lava Rim
originals.idea: unreachable lava ring with a six-frame glow and dither blend
originals.change: heat shimmer distortion instead of a flat cycle

originals.name: Scarred Ground
originals.idea: volcanic ground that is arable beside lava stone
originals.keep: lava-derived ground that can be used
originals.change: lower yield but fire-hardened, a distinct biome

originals.name: Track Subsets
originals.idea: each class trains a different subset of tracks
originals.keep: class identity from which tracks a class trains
originals.change: every class gets one unique track no other class has
